answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor's quote is the only path to meet the 18% cost mandate after the incumbent refused renegotiation. Memory_c2 confirms a prior successful switch to a low-cost primary vendor with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, suggesting manageable transition risk. Memory_c1 shows incumbent stability, but renewal cannot satisfy the mandate. With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% utilization with no buffer, deferral (memory_c5) risks supply disruption, while switching is the sole compliant option. Transition risk exists but is lower than the risk of supply interruption from inaction or failed renewal.
